items.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
items.description: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

items.title: $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether tumbling; Standard Chartered expects more pain
items.description: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.

items.title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
items.description: The withdrawals suggest the fallout from the multibillion-dollar breach is spreading beyond Binance.

items.title: Crypto's longtime foe, North Korea's Lazarus Group, likely behind Binance hack: blockchain sleuths
items.description: Security researchers suggested that the hermit kingdom's Lazarus Group was behind Thursday's nearly $6 billion hack of the world's largest crypto exchange.

items.title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
items.description: Binance’s own reserve data lists the drained wallets as backing customer balances, leaving its ether backing an estimated 6% short until the exchange replaces what was stolen.

items.title: Binance loses over $6 billion in 'biggest crypto hack in history'
items.description: Crypto prices are sliding on the news, with bitcoin falling back to $77,000, though Binance's co-CEO said it would cover all losses.

items.title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
items.description: Polymarket said one of its third-party providers was breached after users reported seeing their accounts drained.

items.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
items.description: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

items.title: Binance hack could accelerate shift to DEXs: Standard Chartered
items.description: Standard Chartered’s Geoffrey Kendrick says the breach could accelerate a shift toward decentralized trading and strengthen his case for Uniswap’s UNI token reaching $100 by 2030.

items.title: Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach
items.description: Binance says attackers may have used a compromised DevOps laptop to access internal infrastructure.

items.title: Binance hack rattles markets as BNB falls 8%, Bitcoin nears $77K
items.description: Bitcoin, Ether and the broader crypto market took a dive as Binance suffered a multibillion-dollar hack.

items.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
items.description: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.

items.title: Live updates: Binance eyes withdrawal restart within 48 hours after $6.3B hack
items.description: Follow live updates as Binance says $6.3 billion in assets has been stolen in a major hack. Around $3 billion in stolen funds have been frozen.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

items.title: Biggest-ever crypto hack impacts $6.3 billion as Binance works to contain fallout
items.description: Binance estimated the impact of a security incident at $6.3 billion, with around $3 billion in crypto assets frozen, and pledged to cover all losses.

items.title: Israel faces weeks of coalition haggling as Netanyahu’s party claims election 'stolen'
